title: Page 188
transc:
No 9  6 Pm
Kelly Cumbd  Wash. Sep. 28. 1864
Jennie for Kelly ---- You
must make the best disposition
to resist the raid in
your power by drawing in
your forces to the most
impt Shoals & having stomach
ready to consent rate them
wherever the Wiley Waldens ----
We cannot help you now
from here Sig Applause ----


No 2  940am
Beckwith City Pt  Wash. Sept. 29. 1864.
Crowd I hope it will
lay no constraint on you
nor do harmony way for 
me to say I am a
little afraid lest Jaunt Sends
venus to Early & thus
Enables him to turn upon
Negus ---- College Nelson franklin
